lines.say: My brother got called lazy at every parents' evening.
Capable, but lazy. Detentions. Isolation rooms.
He knew hundreds of car models before most kids could read.
Effort was never the problem. Starting was. Tracking was. Time was.
He was diagnosed with A D H D at eighteen. After his A-levels.
Nobody ever gave him a plan.
So we built one. Offload holds the plan, so your brain can do the rest.
Comment plan if this was you too.
